usageNote: 旅行圈超爱用的夸张说法，意思是出行经历极其丰富，护照都不够用了！语气自豪又炫酷～

examples.en: She has traveled so much she could fill five passports with stamps.
examples.zh: 她旅行太多了，盖的章能填满五本护照。

examples.en: My grandfather filled five passports before he retired from his adventures.
examples.zh: 我爷爷在结束冒险生涯前，已经用完了五本护照。
